## 🎯 Executive Overview & Curriculum Summary
The AI MBA Handbook (5 Parts, 22 Comprehensive Chapters) bridges classic Ivy League business administration principles with frontier Generative AI:
- **Part 1 (Chapters 1-4):** Foundations, Reality & The First Tools (HBS Case Method Meets AI)
- **Part 2 (Chapters 5-8):** Four Elite Institutions & The Core (Wharton Co-Intelligence, Stanford Lean AI, MIT System Dynamics)
- **Part 3 (Chapters 9-13):** Tools in Action & Prompt Engineering (RTCF, Graph of Thoughts, Chain of Density)
- **Part 4 (Chapters 14-17):** Real-World Business Cases & Organizational Transformation
- **Part 5 (Chapters 18-22):** The Horizon, Frontiers & Thailand's Next S-Curve

---

## ⚡ AI MBA Interactive Prompt Engineering Lab (RTCF Studio)
A dedicated bilingual (Thai / English) interactive web application at `https://aimba.cheeptham.com/prompt-lab.html` featuring:
1. **RTCF Multi-Model Mega-Prompt Wizard:**
   - **R (Role):** Top MBA Professor / Chief Strategy Advisor Persona
   - **C (Context):** User Profession, Business Model, Strengths, Competitors, and Goals
   - **T (Task & Frameworks):** Multi-model chaining combining SWOT, TOWS, BCG Matrix, Blue Ocean ERRC, and Graph of Thoughts (GoT) Verdict in 1-Click
   - **F (Format):** C-Suite Executive Summary Tables & 90-Day Execution Roadmaps
2. **1-Click Presets:** Tailored for SMEs (Coffee Roasters), Health Clinics (Longevity), B2B SaaS, and Omnichannel Retail.
3. **1-Click Quick Launch:** Direct integration with OpenAI ChatGPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Perplexity Pro.
